title: Repair t4's durability gap: carve repair scope out of the source outOfScope, register the 17 unmarked lines, and make the vendor heal path refuse a double declaration
host_restart_required: Yes — no module hot reload in this harness: the live session keeps the PRE-FIX repairScopeFromFindings/matcher until dsh restarts. Every semantic claim here is proven by direct module import or by the guard CLI, never by a live completion gate.

F1.pre_fix: repairScopeFromFindings dropped a finding's file from inScope when the source outOfScope covered it but KEPT the prohibition, so the required edit stayed out_of_scope (the t13 shape)
F1.fix: the covering patterns are carved out of the generated outOfScope and the file is admitted to inScope; unrelated prohibitions preserved; admissions deduplicated
F1.docs_defect_closed: the repairScopeFromFindings doc comment now describes the carve-out, and the self-fix test comment/assertion pair that contradicted itself was corrected to assert in_scope
F1.real_inputs: team mpd-default-7332aba4 t7 + t10 (AGENTS.md required by t10 F3, forbidden by t7)

F2.fix: the three named groups are inside registered regions (scope-overlap, scope-overlap-normalize, create-contract-gate) and the whole pathMatchesScope function now lives inside scope-glob; lib/mpd-deltas.js regenerated to 9 regions
guard_defects_also_closed: writeRegistry could pick an anchor living inside another region (the old scope-glob anchor was a helper declared by scope-glob-core), so a dropped region took its own anchor with it; anchors are now selected outside every region span
--write-registry no longer runs a same-process verification, which could only see the pre-write registry

F3.pre_fix: applyAgentTeamsFixes({write:true}) inserted a region before its anchor without noticing the file still carried the declaration the region replaces; --write and the next --check both exited 0 while the healed file had two `export function pathMatchesScope` and failed to import
F3.fix: insertion refuses when a module-scope name the region declares is still declared OUTSIDE every existing region; the healed file is re-validated (each region exactly once, no region-declared name declared outside it); vendor-agent-teams.mjs turns the refusal into exit 1
F3.verifier_scenario: upstream quality-gates.js + our tools.js/mpd-deltas.js, then the heal path
F3.post_fix: write exit 1 naming pathMatchesScope and line 102; check exit 1; refused file byte-identical to the input with exactly 1 declaration; a clean re-materialize still heals and verifies byte-identical
